ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle, points H, J, K, and G are all on the circumference, and are connected by line segments to form quadrilateral HJKG. Angle H is labeled 2x°, and the angle K opposite it is labeled (x+21)°; in addition, there are also labels about y at angles J and G, but finding angle H does not need to use them. Reasoning: Because HJKG is a cyclic quadrilateral, opposite angles are supplementary. Angle H and angle K are opposite, therefore 2x + (x+21) = 180. Solving gives 3x + 21 = 180, 3x = 159, x = 53. Angle H = 2x = 2(53) = 106°.
